title: A Bird in My Apple Tree

paragraphs.text: I have a big apple tree. It is in my garden. The apples are red and sweet.
paragraphs.translation: 我有一棵大苹果树。它在我家的花园里。树上的苹果又红又甜。

paragraphs.text: A bird lives in the tree. The bird is blue and small. It can sing a nice song. My sister likes the song.
paragraphs.translation: 一只小鸟住在树上。这只鸟是蓝色的，个头小小的。它会唱好听的歌。我妹妹很喜欢这首歌。

paragraphs.text: My dog looks at the bird. He can run and jump. But he cannot fly.
paragraphs.translation: 我的狗看着这只小鸟。它能跑也能跳，可它就是不会飞。

paragraphs.text: My father picks red apples. He puts them in a box. We eat apples every day.
paragraphs.translation: 爸爸摘红苹果。他把苹果放进一个箱子里。我们每天都吃苹果。

paragraphs.text: The bird has a small nest. It is near my window. The nest has three eggs. They are white and round.
paragraphs.translation: 小鸟有一个小小的窝。它就在我的窗户旁边。窝里有三个蛋，又白又圆。

paragraphs.text: I love my apple tree. I love the little bird too. We are good friends.
paragraphs.translation: 我爱我的苹果树，也爱这只小鸟。我们是好朋友。
